Hellooooooooooo Everyoooooone!!

I hope you're having a great day! I wanted to share with you a comic I made back in February. It's about a guy turning into a girl (Shocker) because of crazy mix-up at the doctors office! It's a short 30 page comic. I have no plans of adding anymore to this particular story, so I hope you enjoy it for what it is! :)

And of course if you like what you see here and want to see more,
head on over to my patreon! patreon.com/maideneir
